# Nauiter Master

> Nauiter Master (also written "Nauiter") is an AI Strategist and digital artist with 14+ years in technology, based in Macapá, Brazil, specialized in prompt engineering, creative AI automation and full-stack development with React, TypeScript and Supabase. Official site: https://nauitermaster.com

Nauiter Master is the personal portfolio and professional hub of an AI strategist based in Macapá, Brazil, blending military telecommunications experience, philosophy and digital art with modern AI workflows. The site presents his active platforms, professional background, certifications and creative projects, in Portuguese and English. Nothing is sold on the site: contact happens through the listed channels (email, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook) and the on-site assistant Lucy.

## Projects

- [O Verme Passeia](https://overmepasseia.com.br): Editorial project exploring philosophy and aesthetics through design.
- [Advocacia Figueiredo](https://advocaciafigueiredo.adv.br): Law firm platform connecting law, ethics and AI-assisted technology.
- [Avalia Macapá](https://avaliamacapa.com.br): Urban assessment web platform for mapping and rating local places and services.
- [Oráculo do Caos / Chaos Oracle](https://oraculodocaos.com.br): Digital experience inspired by chaos theory for decision making.
- [QA Master](https://audit-ace-77.lovable.app): Local-first platform for strategic auditing and quality control, with multi-project architecture and gamified QA flows.
- [Nyet Future](https://www.youtube.com/@nyetfuture): Dark/atmospheric music channel built with Suno AI for the international darkwave, coldwave, doomer and post-punk scene.

## Topics

- Prompt engineering for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo, Runway and Suno
- Creative AI automation with Make, Zapier and n8n
- Web and platform development: React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, PostgreSQL
- Quality assurance, testing strategy and auditing workflows
- Digital art, music production with AI, philosophy and design
- Military telecommunications background applied to systems and reliability
